product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone and voice-agent platform that helps sales and support teams manage calls, automate conversations, and analyze customer interactions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes business calling, AI-powered call intelligence, and autonomous voice agents in one platform for sales and support teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page presents pricing plans and a plan comparison.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer stories describe Pipedrive’s own teams using CloudTalk and Verji’s workflows running through CloudTalk, establishing customer usage rather than merely partnership. | named_customers.0: The customer story specifically describes Pipedrive’s global teams using CloudTalk. | named_customers.1: Verji’s customer story directly describes its CloudTalk deployment.

employee_band.notes: CloudTalk’s company profile explicitly gives its size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly names Toronto as headquarters, consistent with the address on its contact page. | hq_country: The company’s contact page explicitly labels its headquarters as Canada HQ.

founded_year.notes: CloudTalk’s company history explicitly states that it was founded in 2016.

eng_blog.notes: The developer blog includes substantive integration-implementation and reliability-testing articles by Josef Lapka, independently identified as CloudTalk’s CPTO. This supports an engineering-led technical blog, although the articles’ generic author footer labels him Senior Copywriter, creating an attribution inconsistency.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple articles, including an API reference, an AI-assistant quickstart, and an HTTP error-code guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists nine current roles, none with a qualifying AI, ML, data-science, scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title. Its stated update date is November 5, 2026.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AssemblyAI, Eleven Labs, and Deepgram
model_provider.notes: CloudTalk’s subprocessor list explicitly connects OpenAI to Conversation Intelligence, Anthropic to voice-agent configuration, Google and AssemblyAI to speech transcription, and Eleven Labs and Deepgram to voice-agent features.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: CloudTalk’s Trust Center names all five requested certifications or compliance frameworks, including a PCI DSS SAQ A 4.0 document; none of these cited claims is described as in progress. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly displays HIPAA. | compliance_certs.3: The Trust Center explicitly displays GDPR. | compliance_certs.4: The Trust Center lists a PCI DSS SAQ A 4.0 document.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement explicitly calls the round Series B, matching the latest round listed in its funding profile. | funding_date: The announcement and latest-round profile give January 17, 2024, normalized to the requested YYYY-MM format. | funding_amount_usd: The company’s funding announcement states $28 million, and its funding profile identifies that Series B as the latest listed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round was announced January 17, 2024, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live inbound Sales Development Representative posting has an application link and also appears on the current company job board.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated November 9, 2026 announcement says CloudTalk launched a rebuilt AI Sales Dialer, a substantive product launch within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying appointment or departure could be verified. Available company information does not provide a complete, dated leadership roster sufficient to establish a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The live SDR posting explicitly instructs employees to capture and track leads using “our HubSpot CRM system,” directly establishing internal use. | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as CloudTalk’s CRM system.
